default.title: Durable agent context, generated briefs, and a connected knowledge map
default.summary: ClawPilot now provides stable per-user agent roles with private and privacy-gated shared context, on-demand document snapshots, clean CRM queue activity, and a verified Map-of-Content second brain.
features: Stable Projects, Pipeline, Docs, Calendar, and ClawPilot profile identities are provisioned automatically for every connected user's own ChatGPT authorization
Layered agent context combines repository-owned role instructions, the selected task thread, private user memory, and vetted shared role principles
New document generation creates user-scoped Build, Project Board, Pipeline, or AI Opportunity snapshots from current accessible data
A root ClawPilot Context Map plus product, platform/data, operations, evolution, and decision Maps of Content
Accepted decision records for data authority, organization-rooted tenancy, CRM identity and synchronization, and local-first knowledge retrieval
Stable note IDs, summaries, areas, tags, reusable Obsidian templates, and automated inbound-link and MOC coverage checks
An intentional owner knowledge catalog that vectors only notes explicitly marked for in-app visibility
fixes: Stops unchanged CRM page reads from writing duplicate synchronization activity after the outbox rejects duplicate work
Gives each real CRM queue event the same deterministic identity boundary as its idempotent outbox operation
Removes historical no-op CRM activity only when no matching SuiteCRM outbox creation exists
Keeps user agent lessons private and requires matching evidence from two independent organizations before a generic lesson can enter shared role context
Rebuilds agent context on every stateless provider request instead of treating a session key as durable memory
Prevents unclassified repository READMEs and compatibility pointers from polluting the vector knowledge catalog
Enforces broken-link, orphan-note, duplicate-ID, metadata, and Map-of-Content density checks before deployment
